post.title: Webhooks Explained: Don't Call Us, We'll Call You
post.subtitle: Polling is slow and wasteful. Webhooks are event-driven callbacks that deliver data the moment something happens.
post.brief: Webhooks let one system push event data to another the moment something happens. Instead of polling ("anything new?"), you expose an endpoint and the provider POSTs signed event payloads to you in near real-time. The key production requirements: signature verification, idempotency, async processing.
